en: Vintage sepia photo postcard showing four uniformed soldiers standing outdoors in winter conditions, likely within a POW camp with wooden barracks in the background. The photo bears a blind embossed censor/approval seal and a photographer credit along the edge. The address side carries printed and stamped Serbian Red Cross information for Geneva, German notations referring to a prisoner-of-war sender from Königsbrück (Saxony), and a handwritten addressee.
